message: Hi, I'm a student with a hadoop certification background. My overall academic average is 81.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in parallel computing and testing. I want to become a Solutions Architect. My family can afford at most about USD 1500 per year. I live in Pune. I'm open to anywhere in India.

other_constraints: interested in parallel computing and testing

explanation:
This program is located in Bengaluru and offers a strong blend of Software Quality Engineering and Software Engineering, which aligns well with your goal of becoming a Solutions Architect. The tuition fee ($1450) is within your budget, and the minimum required grade (54%) is easily met by your 81.8% average.

Since you are based in Pune, this program at Kestrel School of Engineering offers convenience and relevant QA testing skills. The tuition ($1250) is affordable, and the minimum grade requirement (58%) is well below your current academic average.

This option is also in Pune and provides MSc Software Quality Engineering training. With a tuition fee of $1450, it fits your budget constraint. The program focuses on QA testing, which complements your interest in parallel computing and solutions architecture.

This MSc Software Quality Engineering program in Hyderabad is a good fit because it offers high placement rates (86%) and a manageable tuition fee ($1200). While not in Pune, the location is within India and meets all your financial and academic criteria.

This program offers MSc Software Quality Engineering in Kolkata with a low tuition fee ($1200), keeping you within budget. It covers both QA testing and software engineering, providing a broad foundation useful for aspiring Solutions Architects.
